ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a triangular flight route, with the three vertices labeled Phoenix, Des Moines, and Atlanta. The side from Phoenix to Des Moines is labeled 110x + 53, the side from Des Moines to Atlanta is labeled 73.8x, and the base from Phoenix to Atlanta is labeled 150x + 91. Reasoning: The plane flies from Des Moines to Phoenix, then to Atlanta, and finally back to Des Moines, so the total distance is the sum of the three sides of the triangle. The known total distance is 3482 miles, so set up the equation: (110x + 53) + 73.8x + (150x + 91) = 3482. Combining like terms gives 333.8x + 144 = 3482, so 333.8x = 3338, solving gives x = 10. The problem asks for the distance from Des Moines to Phoenix, corresponding to the side length 110x + 53. Substituting x = 10 gives 110(10) + 53 = 1153. Therefore the distance is 1153 miles.
